entry_state: The portable reference binds profile-specific records and typed dependencies while preserving partial financial answers. Its operations distinguish preparation, admission, selection, assessment, authorization, proposal and atomic commit. Reporting, explanation, recovery and store exchange follow.
exit_state: Appendix A closes the proposed operation and record reference. Reports preserve branch and period meaning; storage changes preserve provenance; EPS records retain ordered dilution, exact context and partial outcomes. Appendix B now supplies the teaching grammar, core records and execution rules.
findings: Reporting, explanation and resume retain the frozen semantic context.
Closed accounting records prevent synthetic evidence from authorizing real-book posting.
Ordered EPS uses exact context, complete inventory and explicit unsupported or unresolved states.
Company-to-EPS projection binds the correct numerator, weighted shares and dated windows; two documentary worlds do not establish arbitrary-company support. No new confirmed manuscript defect.
